summary: Actelis Networks filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing the elimination of the Chief Revenue Officer, Americas position effective August 1, 2026, resulting in the departure of Mark DeVol. The filing states the termination did not arise from any disagreement with the company regarding operations, policies, or practices. This is a forced/abrupt executive departure tied to organizational restructuring and cost-reduction efforts. No deal terms, price, premium, advisors, or board recommendation are mentioned. The event is isolated; readers should monitor for further restructuring announcements or additional executive changes.
